verses.note: Christians have long connected circumcision with baptism because Colossians 2:11-12 links the two. Those who baptize infants see in Isaac's eighth-day circumcision a covenant sign given to a child before he could believe; those who baptize believers only hold that the New Testament sign follows faith and that the link in Colossians is spiritual rather than a pattern for infants. Both positions are held by faithful churches.
